Bear
These large and powerful omnivores are generally not dangerous unless they are extremely hungry, they have been disturbed by encroaching civilization, their young are threatened, or they have been driven away from their natural territory or habitat—all occurrences that have become far more common with the ongoing wars and supernatural transformations that currently plague many places in the world.

	Perception

Skill Ranks
* Athletics +10
* Awareness +10
* Coordination +10
* Intimidate +10
* Survival +10
* Taijutsu +10
* Toughness +10


Attacks
* Bite: 55% - Distance (Melee Engaged) - Damage (2d6+5) - Punishing, Vicious
* Claw:  55% - Distance (Melee Engaged) - Damage (2d6+5) - Punishing, Sweeping
Techniques
* N/A
Traits
* Honed Smell: This creature's sense of smell is heightened, making smell-related Awareness tests easier (+20%).
* Thick Hide (4): This creature treats its Damage Threshold as (4) higher. This number is already factored into its traits.
* Maul (3 Misfortune, 3 AP, Combat Action): This creature makes the same attack up to three times without suffering Multiple Attack Penalties.

Shinobi




Genin (Rime)
Barely out of the academy but eager to prove themselves, the Genin of the Village Hidden in the Rime are a hardy folk who specialize in Close Quarters Combat.




Combat
	Brawn
	Agility
	Perception
	Intelligence
	Willpower
	Fellowship
	45% [5]
	50% [6]
	40% [4]
	40% [4]
	35% [3]
	45% [4]
	40% [4]
	Parry
	Damage Threshold
	Movement
	Dodge
	Initiative
	Size
	Peril Threshold
	Chakra Pool
	Threat Rating
	55%
	6
	7
	50%
	7
	Small (+0d6 damage) or Normal (+1d6 dmg)
	7
	10
	Genin: Low
	



Skill Ranks
* Bukijutsu +10
* Coordination +10
* Ninjutsu/Genjutsu +10
* Stealth +10


Attacks
* Kunai: 55% - Distance (Ranged 8 paces) - Load (1AP) - Damage (1d6+4) - Finesse, Light, Silent
* Shuriken: 55% - Distance (Ranged 9 paces) - Load (1AP) - Damage (1d6+4) - Fast, Finesse, Inaccurate
* Unarmed:  45% - Distance (Melee Engaged) - Damage (1d6+6) - Pummelling, Slow


Techniques
* Secret Stance -  Wild Bear (1 AP): 45% - 1 Chakra (Maintained: 1 Chakra/Round)
   * You move slow but steady, emulating the thrashing attacks of a wild bear. You take a -2 penalty to your Damage Threshold, but gain a +2 bonus Taijutsu attack damage. All Taijutsu and Bukijutsu attacks gain the Pummeling Quality (if they didn’t already have it).
* Blade Rush (1 AP): 55% - 2 Chakra
   * Make a single attack with your held weapon. If the attack hits, you deal normal damage and the target is pushed back [BB] Paces if they fail a Challenging (-10%) Coordination test. If the target is pushed back, you may follow after them for free as part of this technique.
* Wind Scythe (3 AP): 55% - 4 Chakra - Ray
   * You fire a curved blade of wind, dealing 1d6 Power Die of damage to any creature in the area who fails a Coordination test to Avoid it




Traits
* Ambush Tactics: These creatures roll 2D10 to determine Initiative.
* Desperate Assault (2 Misfortune, 1 AP, Combat Action): This creature can use this Trait only when they have suffered at least 3 levels of Damage. They gain +20 to all Combat-based Skill tests and add an extra Damage die to all Attacks for the remainder of this Combat Scene.
